newsitem.title: USA: Mountasia Entertainment Q4 loss widens.
newsitem.headline: Mountasia Entertainment Q4 loss widens.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Full company name is Mountasia Entertainment International Inc.

Period-to-period consolidated results of operations are not comparable because of significant acquisitions in each period, changes in the company's capital structure, decisions regarding the company's future and other factors.
1996 Q4 share loss includes $26.1 million, or $0.93 a share, non-recurring charges and expenses from repositioning and recapitalization.
1995 Q4 operating revenues include about $300,000 from discontinued development and construction.
1996 year net loss includes $30.3 million, or $1.74 a share, non-recurring charges from recapitalization.
1995 operating revenues include $11.9 million from development and construction revenues from third parties.
